record.rationale: Adapts browser file, clipboard, download, and IndexedDB ports while document operations remain owned by SwDocShell and transfer creation remains owned by SwTransferable/SwWrtShell.
responsibilities: Binds browser ports to shell-owned file/storage operations.
Owns the Sfx command shell that terminates browser-only file, storage, and clipboard commands outside SwView.
Surfaces platform failures through Sfx asynchronous command completion instead of a parallel workflow status model.

stackDivergence.rationale: Browser APIs and React presentation replace native VCL, system clipboard, file dialog, and desktop storage boundaries.
